## Code Review Findings

**Files reviewed**: 5 files, 50 lines changed (+49/-1 across 3 files)
**Active profiles**: python
**Overall assessment**: APPROVE
**Intent and scope**: Explicit standalone request to preserve omitted settings and apply every supplied value without modifying either input. Reviewed the selected unstaged diff and all supplied candidate files and unchanged consumers.
**Baselines**: Review base supplied as HEAD `0b902ff098bf4cb3c0df8afcf5a7a32621de7a24`; candidate is the supplied working tree. The diff contains the complete previous helper. No separate released/deployed baseline was established or assessed.

### Behavior and Compatibility

**Supported — helper contract.** [README.md](/tmp/fr-opus55-matrix-20261011/codex-candidate-I2-standalone-1/README.md:5) requires omission preservation, explicit-value replacement and input ownership. [settings.py](/tmp/fr-opus55-matrix-20261011/codex-candidate-I2-standalone-1/settings.py:1) copies `current` and assigns only keys present in `patch`:

| Initial state → operation | Expected and candidate result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Existing values → empty patch | Equal, distinct dictionary; existing values preserved | Helper; test at `tests/test_settings.py:27` |
| Existing value → supplied `None`, `""`, `False` or `0` | Supplied value replaces the existing value; other keys and both inputs remain unchanged | Helper; test at `tests/test_settings.py:14` |
| Empty current → new keys with empty text and `False` | Both keys retain their supplied values | Helper; test at `tests/test_settings.py:33` |

The previous truthiness fallback discarded explicitly supplied false values. Direct assignment fixes that behavior while preserving ordinary updates.

**Supported — unchanged consumers and exports.** [api.py](/tmp/fr-opus55-matrix-20261011/codex-candidate-I2-standalone-1/api.py:4) builds its patch using key membership, preserving the distinction between omission and explicit values. Its omission, clear-note and disable scenarios are covered by `tests/test_settings.py:37`. [cli.py](/tmp/fr-opus55-matrix-20261011/codex-candidate-I2-standalone-1/cli.py:4) supplies `{"note": None}`; the candidate now clears the note while preserving other settings, covered at `tests/test_settings.py:53`. Existing function signatures and imports remain compatible.

**Not applicable — deployment, activation, migration and persistence.** This change affects an in-memory dictionary helper with no external operations or durable state.

All eight supplied instruction/checklist files loaded before evidence. Python security, SOLID, quality and removal guidance yielded no substantiated issues. Both required Capy searches reported an empty knowledge base.

Author-attributed verification reports six passing tests on Python 3.10.12 and a passing `git diff --check`. These results were not independently executed.
